name: ui-verifier
description: Tests a macOS app's UI hands-free: off-screen launch, Accessibility-tree gates, screenshot capture with vision review, and golden AX-tree snapshot regression — every number measured, nothing advertised it cannot deliver.

interface.shortDescription: Autonomous, hands-free UI testing for a macOS app via Accessibility.
interface.longDescription: A dual-host agent plugin that tests a macOS app's UI without touching the screen or a mouse: off-screen launch, Accessibility-condition waits instead of fixed sleeps, a content+pressable gate counted per viewport, screenshot capture with an honest two-cause failure message, a vision review of every capture, and a golden AX-tree snapshot method for regression. Every number is measured; a check that did not run is reported NOT RUN, never guessed.
defaultPrompt: Test this app's UI end to end.
